prompt: The query in the editor has one mistake. Fix it so that it answers this question: which Echoline products cost Voltmarkt from 100 to 250 euros? From the products table, return three columns, in this order: product_id, product_name, unit_cost_eur. Keep only the products whose brand is Echoline and whose unit_cost_eur is from 100 to 250 euros, both ends included. Every product has a brand and a unit_cost_eur. Show unit_cost_eur exactly as stored, without rounding. Return one row per product. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, check the range test in the row filter, and which end of the range comes first.
BETWEEN needs the low end first and the high end second. With the ends the other way round, no value can fall inside the range.
starter_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE brand = 'Echoline' AND unit_cost_eur BETWEEN 250 AND 100
why_this_works: BETWEEN 100 AND 250 keeps the costs from 100 to 250, both ends included. With the high end first, no cost fits.
